transcript:
[turn 1] [user] Can you find me something economical to eat in Pleasanton.
[turn 2] [assistant] Are you looking for Italian, Indian or something else?
[turn 3] [user] I would like some Italian food.
[turn 4] [assistant] Found 5 restaurants for you out of which De La Torre's Trattoria seems a great from Pleasanton.
[turn 5] [user] Can you provide the address and do they have live music?
[turn 6] [assistant] No, they do not have live music and its address is 6025 West Las Positas Boulevard.
[turn 7] [user] Any other recommendation?
[turn 8] [assistant] Forno Vecchio also seems nice and its located n Pleasanton as well.
[turn 9] [user] Can you provide more options?
[turn 10] [assistant] Another good restaurant in Pleasanton in Gay 90's Pizza Co.
[turn 11] [user] That sounds like a good choice for me.
[turn 12] [assistant] Is there anything else?
[turn 13] [user] Yes, make a reservation at the restaurant.
[turn 14] [assistant] What time do you want me to make the reservation?
[turn 15] [user] I'll reach there at 1:30 pm.
[turn 16] [assistant] Please confirm that you want to make a reservation at Gay 90's Pizza Co. which is located in Pleasanton for 2 people. The reservation is for today at 1:30 pm.
[turn 17] [user] No, change the time to 7 pm and for one person only.
[turn 18] [assistant] Alright, please confirm that the reservation is at 7 pm for 1 person.
[turn 19] [user] No, change it on next friday.
[turn 20] [assistant] Sure. Please confirm that the date is now next Friday and for 1 person.
[turn 21] [user] Yes. Sounds good.
[turn 22] [assistant] Your reservation is booked.
[turn 23] [user] What is the address of the restaurant and do the have live music?
[turn 24] [assistant] The address is 288 Main Street and No, they don't have live music either.
[turn 25] [user] Alright, Thank you.
[turn 26] [assistant] Have a great day.
